title: Open Robotics RViz AxisColorPCTransformer PointField Out-Of-Bounds Read Denial-of-Service… (CVE-2026-134050)
description: A denial-of-service vulnerability exists in Open Robotics RViz's AxisColorPCTransformer component due to an out-of-bounds read in handling PointCloud2 messages. This flaw allows network-adjacent attackers to cause a denial-of-service without requiring authentication.
